definitions: To continue from the point where an activity or conversation was previously stopped.
To resume a task or relationship after an interruption.
examples: After a long break, they were able to pick up where they left off with their project.
It was easy for them to pick up where they left off, even after years apart.
Let's pick up where we left off in our discussion yesterday.
lemma: pick up where one left off
